_note: Every field is OPTIONAL except `file`; the scorer only grades the fields you provide. `total` = amount PAID (after discounts). `vat_rate` = the dominant printed rate. `tags` = receipt-type labels for the by-type accuracy breakdown (free-form, e.g. rotated/multi_rate/discount/payment_only/no_vat/crumpled). `_note` is ignored by the scorer.
`vendor_alt` lists other acceptable vendor names (e.g. platform vs merchant). Omit `vat_amount`/`vat_rate` when the receipt prints no VAT table. A receipt counts toward every tag it carries.
